info.name: Beranda - Hero Carousel
info.description:
CRUD section hero carousel pada beranda.

Dua bagian:
1. content-service (admin) - kelola section hero_carousel di menu beranda. JWT (Authorization: Bearer) + role super_admin/admin_pusat/admin_pustik.
2. public-content-service (public) - baca section beranda untuk frontend.

Base URL local dev:
- Admin:   http://localhost:4076/content-service/api
- Public:  http://localhost:4076/public-content-service/api

PENTING: hero_carousel REFERENCE-ONLY. Setiap slide WAJIB merujuk item konten existing. Slide custom/inline TIDAK diperbolehkan.

Payload per slide (admin):
- source_type  (WAJIB) publication | repository | gallery
- source_id    (WAJIB) ID baris di tabel detail sumber (content_detail_publications.id dst)
- button_text  (opsional) override teks tombol CTA (satu-satunya field inline yang bisa di-override)

Saat dibaca admin API (GET /section/{id}) maupun public API, backend RESOLVE dari sumber (Eloquent + eager-load, no N+1):
- image_path, title, subtitle dari item sumber
- tag dari first tag sumber (contentTag.tag.title)
- button_link auto dari slug sumber (/berita/slug, /repository/slug, /galeri/slug)

Mapping: publication->thumbnail_path/title/headline(/berita/slug), repository->thumbnail_path/title/description(/repository/slug), gallery->gambar pertama list/title/description(/galeri/slug).

Autoplay interval ditangani frontend (tidak disimpan di backend).

response.name: 422 - Validasi gagal (hero_carousel wajib referensi)

request.description: hero_carousel reference-only: tiap slide WAJIB punya source_type (publication|repository|gallery) + source_id (ID baris di tabel detail sumber). Hanya button_text yang bisa di-override inline. button_link auto dari slug sumber. source_id wajib ada di tabel sumber, else 422.
